digest.component_or_area: code-review overlay routing (tests overlay content trigger)
propositions: The tests overlay is currently selected only by glob matching on changed file paths (test_*.py, *_test.py, tests/**), missing code reviews that add declarations without test file changes and later produce bugs

The overlay must be content-triggered when a diff adds function/class/method declarations in non-test files and makes no changes to test files, detected via declaration regex on added (+) lines with per-file name-suppression logic

The detector must extract declared names (separate from the declaration regex which has no capture group) and suppress triggers for annotation-only rewrites where names are both added and removed in the same file, while failing closed on anonymous declarations

The trigger implementation must pass changed_files as a keyword-only parameter to content_triggered_overlays and must be portable across languages and layouts (Go func, TS/JS function/arrow/class, Rust fn, Ruby class) using the existing polyglot regex, excluding only docs/data file extensions

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must narrow to block only coverage gaps in newly-introduced (added-line) behavior with named violating inputs, leaving pre-existing-code gaps advisory, with prompt wording decidable from the diff alone

The overlay_union description must name the added-declaration content trigger alongside the existing glob trigger, and no test regressions or complexity-baseline increases should result from registry.py changes
